long_biography.plain_text:
Joseph Michael “Joe” Sipes was born in Rushville, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Illinois University. He joined G.M. Sipes Construction, the heavy-highway contractor owned by his father, and worked there for more than four decades before becoming its owner and operator.

The company competed for municipal and state pavement, highway and civil works across Illinois. Sipes also served on the board of the Associated General Contractors of Illinois, linking his operating role to the wider industry. In 2021, long-serving colleagues Corey Ingles and Pete Hamm became part owners, preceding Sipes's retirement. He died in Fort Lauderdale in December 2024.
